name: Council Vagn

facts.text: Vagn is a level-78 Council member with 100,000 health, linked to Council Nokkvi: pull one and both come.
A 2005 Allakhazam comment says the pair resisted every spell and the tanks hit Nokkvi for almost nothing; someone had to kite Vagn.
Old Norse vagn means wagon, and nokkvi a kind of boat (both to verify).

story: Vagn and Nokkvi are named for a wagon and a boat, because in the Council's early days they carried everything between them: the votes, the gossip, the grudges. They still go everywhere together. Vagn is the talker, with a frost shock to end an argument; Nokkvi is the one who listens and does not fall down. The Council says you cannot move one without the other, and the Council has rarely been more right. They argued for peace together and they will die together, and neither would have it any other way.
legend: Vagn and Nokkvi come as a pair and have huge resists. One group kites or holds Vagn while the raid works Nokkvi, or the reverse. Don't stand casters in Vagn's frost shock range. When one dies the other grieves loudly and hits harder for it, so have the second kill planned before the first one drops.

aggro: Nokkvi, they have come to the Council uninvited.

phases.text: Nokkvi! Who will carry the vote now?

lairEntry: Two council seats stand side by side, worn alike.
atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Councils Vagn and Nokkvi have fallen together.
